summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests abemaciclib given with radiation therapy before surgery for high-risk adipocytic retroperitoneal sarcoma. Abemaciclib is taken by mouth twice a day on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 3 cycles, and radiation therapy is given in 28 fractions starting on cycle 1 day 15, with surgery possible afterward. The study measures safety, side effects, and the best dose of abemaciclib; it is a Phase 1 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa abemaciclib administrado junto con radioterapia antes de la cirugía para el sarcoma retroperitoneal adipocítico de alto riesgo. El abemaciclib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día, los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, durante hasta 3 ciclos, y la radioterapia se administra en 28 fracciones a partir del día 15 del ciclo 1, con la posibilidad de cirugía después. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis de abemaciclib; es un ensayo de Fase 1.
who_for: Newly diagnosed or locally recurrent MDM2 or CDK4-amplified adipocytic sarcoma with a dedifferentiated component
At least one measurable tumor on CT or MRI
Tumor judged surgically resectable, with plans for radiation therapy followed by surgery
not_for: Prior anticancer therapy for this diagnosis, or prior radiation to the affected area
Known brain or central nervous system metastases, or distant metastatic disease
Thromboembolic event within 1 year of treatment start
